clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Raptor Head trophies answer a bounty from Gazrog at the Crossroads. The guard payroll vanished from a watchtower, and a wild raptor was caught in the theft.

A stolen chest of guard payroll has left the Crossroads watchtower without its silver. The defenders caught a wild raptor red-handed, to their disbelief. Gazrog has put a bounty on the cunning reptiles prowling the Barrens. Bring their severed heads to the outpost, and the predators will be culled before they can pilfer more Horde supplies.
